key_insight: This study shows that LLMs can look highly accurate on clean healthcare workflow tasks yet still fail to escalate or ask for clarification when uncertainty, conflict, or missing evidence appears.
clinical_relevance: For healthcare AI, the main risk is not just wrong answers but missed workflow actions like escalation, which can affect safety and decision quality.
method: 400 synthetic workflow episodes built from 40 hand-authored seeds
Two surface forms and five controlled perturbation variants across four task classes
Compared five open-weight LLM configurations using ANSWER / ASK CLARIFICATION / ABSTAIN / ESCALATE under a 5:1 missed-escalation cost
evidence_signal: Clean decision accuracy reached 0.97, but under conflict the strongest model dropped to 0.78 and missed-escalation rates remained high without a workflow-aware controller.
watch_item: The proposed controller improves benchmark performance, but its rule detectors failed on paraphrased triggers, so generalization beyond this benchmark is not yet established.
paper_title: Auditing Escalation Reliability in Healthcare LLM Agents: A Perturbation-Controlled Benchmark of Workflow-State Failures
